# BestBuy.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/bestbuy-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/bestbuy-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects property listing data from BestBuy.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape BestBuy Product, Offer and Review Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-bestbuy-product-offer-and-review-data)
- **Code:** [`bestbuy.py`](bestbuy.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Sitemap pages](results/promos.json) · [Product pages](results/products.json) · [Review pages](results/reviews.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- BestBuy sitemaps for URLs.
- BestBuy product pages for product data.
- BestBuy search pages for product data on search pages.
- BestBuy review pages for review data

## Functions

- `scrape_sitemaps(url)` → `List[str]`: scrape link data from bestbuy sitemap
- `scrape_products(urls, max_review_pages=1)` → `List[Dict]`: scrapy product data from bestbuy product pages
- `scrape_search(search_query, sort=None, max_pages=None)`: scrape search data from bestbuy search
- `scrape_reviews(skuid, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape review data from the reviews API

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import bestbuy


async def main():
    sitemaps = await bestbuy.scrape_sitemaps(url="https://sitemaps.bestbuy.com/sitemaps_promos.0000.xml.gz")
    search = await bestbuy.scrape_search(search_query="macbook", max_pages=3)
    reviews = await bestbuy.scrape_reviews(skuid="6565065", max_pages=3)


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/products.json`](results/products.json): `product-info`, `product-features`, `product-faq`, `buying-options`
- [`results/reviews.json`](results/reviews.json): `id`, `topicType`, `rating`, `recommended`, `title`, `text`, `author`, `positiveFeedbackCount`, `negativeFeedbackCount`, `commentCount`, `writeCommentUrl`, `submissionTime`, `brandResponses`, `badges`, `photos`, `qualityRating`, `valueRating`, `easeOfUseRating`, `daysOfOwnership`, `pros`, `cons`, `secondaryRatings`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `name`, `link`, `images`, `sku`, `price`, `original_price`, `rating`, `rating_count`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`bestbuy.py`](bestbuy.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/bestbuy-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_sitemap_scraping`, `test_review_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
